text: Fight automatically when the item was delivered and the amount is under $50
explanation: For 'item not received' disputes up to $50 where tracking shows delivery, contest the claim without asking.

text: If the buyer was charged twice, refund right away
explanation: For duplicate-charge disputes of any amount, refund without asking.

text: Refund automatically if the parcel was lost or never shipped and it's under $30
explanation: For 'item not received' disputes up to $30 with a lost parcel or no tracking, refund without asking.
